title: High Molecular Weight DNA Extraction from Actinomycetota
author: Ashley Paulsen

steps.title: Grow Actinomycetota culture
steps.instruction: Incubate cultures shaking in half‑strength TSB supplemented with 0.5 % glycine for 36–48 h.

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin down cultures at 4500 × g for 10 min at room temperature and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash cell pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 500 µL 1× PBS, centrifuge, and remove the supernatant; cells may be frozen at –80 °C for storage.

steps.title: Resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet in 200 µL 1× PBS.

steps.title: Lyse cells with sucrose buffer
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL sucrose lysis buffer, vortex, and incubate at 37 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Add SDS and Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL 10 % SDS (final 1 % SDS) and 50 µL Proteinase K (Life Technologies catalog #17916, 20 mg mL⁻¹ stock); rotate the tube end‑over‑end 5 times to mix.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 50 °C for 2 h, rotating end‑over‑end slowly every 30 min (3 rotations each time).

steps.title: Transfer lysate
steps.instruction: Pour the viscous lysate into fresh 15 mL conical centrifuge tubes.

steps.title: First phenol extraction
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL freshly opened BioUltra TE‑saturated phenol (Merck MilliporeSigma catalog #77607, pH ≈ 8.0, use within 3 months) to each tube, mix on a ~20 rpm end‑over‑end mixer for 10 min (increase speed if emulsion does not form after 1 min).

substeps.instruction: Pipette off the organic (phenol) phase and discard, taking care not to remove the aqueous phase; remove any white protein precipitate.
Centrifuge at 6000 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: To the recovered aqueous phase add 2.5 mL BioUltra phenol (catalog #77607) and 2.5 mL 24:1 chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol (Supelco catalog #25666); mix on a ~20 rpm end‑over‑end mixer for 10 min.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 6000 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.
Pipette off the organic phase and discard, preserving the aqueous layer.
Centrifuge again at 6000 rpm for 5 min at room temperature to ensure complete removal of the organic phase.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Pour the final aqueous phase into a new 50 mL conical centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL cold 5 M ammonium acetate, rock the tube back‑and‑forth three times to mix.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation overnight
steps.instruction: Add 15 mL ice‑cold 100 % ethanol, chill ethanol beforehand, and incubate the tube at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Collect DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Melt the tip of a glass pipette over a Bunsen burner to form a small hook, hook out the precipitated DNA mass, dip it briefly in 70 % ethanol, and transfer it to a labeled microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: First 70 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL 70 % ethanol to the tube, then spin at 10 000 × g for 2 min; remove as much ethanol as possible.

steps.title: Second 70 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add another 1 mL 70 % ethanol, spin at 10 000 × g for 2 min, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Allow residual ethanol to evaporate by leaving the tube at room temperature for 15 min (placing tubes on their side in a laminar flow hood speeds drying).

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in Tris
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 8.0) elution buffer and incubate without mixing at 4 °C for 24 h to allow the pellet to dissolve into a translucent viscous gel.

steps.title: Homogenize DNA solution
steps.instruction: Slowly pipette‑mix the DNA 5–10 times with a wide‑bore pipette (or cut P200), incubate on a 37 °C heating block for 30–60 min, then pipette‑mix again 5–10 times.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a NanoDrop in triplicate (bottom, middle, top of the sample); if readings differ, repeat the homogenization step. Once consistent, the DNA is ready for Qubit quantification and downstream use.

steps.title: Optional secondary precipitation
steps.instruction: Take an aliquot of DNA, add an equal volume of precipitation buffer, flick to mix, then add 1 mL 70 % ethanol, tap to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 6–18 h.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 15 min at 10 000 g (≈10 000 rpm).
Carefully pipette off the supernatant, leaving 10–20 µL, and discard.
Centrifuge for 2 min at 10 000 g and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the 70 % ethanol wash and let the pellet dry for ~15 min.
Add the desired volume of 10 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 8.0) elution buffer and incubate at 4 °C.
